summary: The new audit report (ai-os/audits/projexa_erp_e2e_reaudit_2026-07-27.md) and the ACTIVE-CLAIMS.yaml addition are sound and were independently spot-checked against real repo state, not taken on faith: compliance-tracker's computeHierarchicalAmount()/parentLineItemId/breakdownPercentage (construction-boq-service.ts, schema.ts) and construction-valuation-service.ts genuinely exist and match the report's claims, and projexa's per-scope IndexedDB queue (src/lib/offline/work-progress-queue.ts, on main @699d9e7) and the last-owner/admin demotion guard (src/app/api/org-members/[id]/route.ts, wasOwnerOrAdmin/willBeOwnerOrAdmin) genuinely exist as described, including the specific commits cited (b5014d9, 173b9ab, 114d0ee). However, PROGRESS.md is not actually report-only as this PR's own 'Remaining' line claims: at the merge base (df665722), PROGRESS.md held 281 lines of real prior-task history (task-132826 budget-undercount fix, task-100954 HR gaps, task-101123 PM gaps, task-093117 sharp-CVE/BoQ-hierarchy sections), verified via `git cat-file -p 345391e1`. This PR nets it down to 57 lines, a real loss of ~224 lines of that record. Commit 031584cd's message claims to have 'restored prior tasks' progress notes ... matching the convention already visible in main's history,' but it only reattached a 32-line fragment that itself already carries a stale, truncated '... more files changed' placeholder -- not the true full content. So the self-report (both the commit message and this task's own PROGRESS.md entry) is inaccurate about what the diff actually does, which is the exact class of thing this review is meant to catch even though the file itself is low-blast-radius documentation recoverable from git history.
issues: PROGRESS.md nets ~224 lines of deleted historical task-progress content (task-132826, task-100954, task-101123, task-093117 sections) despite commit 031584cd's message claiming a full restore 'matching main's history' -- only a 32-line, already-truncated fragment was reattached, not the real df665722 content (281 lines, confirmed via git cat-file -p 345391e1). Fix: rebuild PROGRESS.md from the real df665722 blob and append this task's new section below it, rather than relying on `git show <rev>:<path>` output, which truncates around line 31 with a spurious '... more files changed' marker in at least this review environment -- likely what fooled the original restore attempt into treating a truncated snippet as complete.
This PR's own PROGRESS.md entry claims 'report-only, no other file changes,' which is inaccurate -- PROGRESS.md itself is being destructively rewritten, not just appended to.
